claims.text: Multiple deficiencies are common: a balanced diet incl other B vitamins (esp riboflavin, pyridoxine) is needed.
claims.quote: Because multiple deficiencies are common, a balanced diet, including other B vitamins (particularly riboflavin and pyridoxine), is needed.

claims.text: Nicotinamide is USU used: unlike nicotinic acid it doesn't cause flushing, itching, burning or tingling.
claims.quote: Nicotinamide is usually used to treat niacin deficiency because nicotinamide, unlike nicotinic acid (the most common form of niacin), does not cause flushing, itching, burning, or tingling sensations.
